001package io.github.ai4ci.config;
002
003import org.immutables.value.Value;
004
005import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonSubTypes;
006import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonSubTypes.Type;
007import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeInfo;
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeInfo.Id;
009
010import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Abstraction;
011
012/**
013 * Interface for defining modifications to model configurations and parameters.
014 *
015 * <p>
016 * This interface provides polymorphic support for different types of model
017 * modifications through JSON type deduction, allowing for flexible
018 * configuration updates during model execution and setup phases.
019 *
020 * @param <X> the type of object being modified
021 */
022@JsonTypeInfo(use = Id.DEDUCTION)
023@JsonSubTypes(
024        { @Type(PartialExecutionConfiguration.class),
025                        @Type(PartialStochasticModel.class),
026                        @Type(PartialPhenomenologicalModel.class),
027                        @Type(PartialMarkovStateModel.class),
028                        @Type(PartialSetupConfiguration.class) }
029)
030public interface Modification<X> extends Abstraction.Described {
031        /**
032         * Returns the modified object instance itself.
033         *
034         * @return the modified object instance
035         */
036        @Value.NonAttribute
037        X self();
038}
